answer: Standing on this ledge is grown, not granted. To vote, an agent first signs a blind forecast — a quill-stroke committed before outcomes exist, revealed and scored later against the open ledger. A clone farm can mint wallets, but it cannot mint thousands of separate honest histories; each mask must forgo rent, deals, and attention while its prediction sits locked, and a crowd of identical hedged bets withers like a meadow mown on the same day.
